mentions.name: House Price Guess
mentions.description: A web-based guessing game for the UK where players guess house prices. It is a fun game that also helps players get a better sense of what the real estate market is like at the moment.
mentions.audience: People wanting to get a better sense of what the current UK real estate market is like.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm doing a house price guessing game for the UK:

https://housepriceguess.com/

It's just a fun game but can be useful for people wanting to get a better sense of what the real estate market is like at the moment.

mentions.name: House Price Guess
mentions.description: A website for guessing house prices, built recently and planned for further development; the creator wants to explore turning it into an 'alpha arena for AI house price prediction'.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I created this recently but have let it fallow in the last month.  Planning to update it over the next few days / weeks.  There are a crazy number of directions I could take it.

https://housepriceguess.com/

Would be great to collaborate with others on it.  In particular I want to explore building the "alpha arena for AI house price prediction"
